title: Size Uplift for Duplicate Domain Charges — Harborline Customer Accounts
content:
# Size uplift

**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts, for duplicate auto-renew charges on Domain Registrations

The size uplift of the duplicate-charge goodwill follows the duplicate charge's amount: $50.00 or more adds $5.00, $15.00 or more but less than $50.00 adds $2.00, and less than $15.00 adds nothing. The uplift is a fixed sum added to the duplicate-charge goodwill figure.

| Duplicate charge amount | Uplift |
|---|---|
| $50.00 and above | $5.00 |
| $15.00 up to $49.99 | $2.00 |
| below $15.00 | none |

Boundary readings: a duplicate of exactly $50.00 adds $5.00; one of exactly $15.00 adds $2.00; one of $14.99 adds nothing.
